company.name: Vega Health
company.shortDescription: Vega Health connects health systems with curated AI tools, offering evaluation, governance, deployment, and monitoring support.
company.description: Vega Health connects health systems with vetted artificial intelligence tools through a platform that supports discovery, evaluation, and deployment. The product integrates vendor information, governance workflows, and risk assessments to help organizations compare solutions for clinical and operational use cases. Capabilities include validation frameworks, performance monitoring, and bias and safety reviews to support accountable AI adoption. Implementation services use co-design with clinicians and administrators to align models to workflow, integrate with existing systems, and measure outcomes. The company also offers support for procurement, contracting, and lifecycle management of AI applications across the enterprise.
